details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:285-383 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In dispatch_watch_alt_model_runner_wait, a queued candidate whose job is held is appended to `alt_rw_ids` before the held check and then to `alt_rw_held_ids`, so it appears twice in `alt_rw_all` and is cancel-POSTed twice; if listed first, `${alt_rw_ids%%,*}` also passes a held run to `dispatch_watch_stop_release_gate` as `watched_run`.
  WHY: The second POST hits a run that is already cancelling and prints a spurious `::warning::Could not cancel alt-model run #<id>`, and the RELEASE_GATE_RUNNER_WAIT line that operators and heal intake read can name a held run, which contradicts the header comment that a held queued candidate "never counts as the early candidate". All reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:392-397 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Each of the four status listings in dispatch_watch_cancel_issue_runs (`per_page=100`, repo-wide `created=>` filter) reads only page 1, never checks `total_count` and logs no warning when the listing is cut off.
  WHY: Under a deep queue (57+ live queued runs, a 487-run jam), the test issue's runs past page 1 are silently left queued and holding runners, which defeats the step exactly when it matters. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated NIT; minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated MAJOR, so the highest is used.
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:351 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The alt-model runner-wait check's run listings (`in_progress`, `queued`, `pending`, `waiting`) in alt_rw_candidates use `per_page=100` and do not paginate or check `total_count`.
  WHY: During a deep queue jam, runs past page 1 are ignored, so runner-wait detection is incomplete and active runs waiting for runners are not cancelled. Rated MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 notes that this check does guard truncation via `alt_rw_in_progress_total -gt 100` → `listing_truncated`.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:2106-3030,5185-5297 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `if: cancelled()` step "Cancel the test issue's runs when the gate is cancelled" in e2e-smoke-test (line 3022, or 3014 per minimax) and e2e-alt-model-test (line 5290, or 5282 per minimax) runs after earlier `always()` steps: run-ID capture, the LLM-calling soft-error analysers, and the review analyser with its 300-second wait cap at 2114-2115.
  WHY: After a runner-wait gate stop, the test issue's clarify/plan/implement runs keep queueing or holding runners until those steps finish, which undermines G3's early release. Severity disagreement: minimax_minimax-m3 rated MAJOR; all others rated NIT, so the highest is used.
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:379-394 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The dispatch_watch_cancel_issue_runs header comment, the README `DISPATCH_WATCH_STOP_RELEASE_GATE` row and agents.d/10037-release-gate-runner-wait.md all claim review runs are cancelled, but the `display_title == $title` filter never matches review runs, whose title is the PR title or "Internal: AI Review & Autofix [pr:N]".
  WHY: This is a documentation and intent mismatch with no crash: review runs are still freed indirectly because the always() cleanup closes the PR and cancel_on_pr_close then cancels them. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:137-144 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The gate-stop check treats every failed or timed-out gate step as a real failure, including a sibling watcher step that failed because it also detected runner_wait.
  WHY: Gate test jobs run in parallel. If another runner-wait watcher has already failed, `stop_real` is nonzero and the function refuses to cancel, so the gate fails and spends an attempt even though its failures were runner waits. Rated MAJOR.
- scripts/auto_release_stable.sh:808 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The runner-wait check runs a new query (re-parsing `runs_json`) to find the newest gate run ID.
  WHY: The workflow runs are already listed at line 758, so the check should reuse the already-parsed `runs_json`. Rated NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: G3: "The gate then stops early, cancels the child runs it started, and the cycle ends with a conclusion the release scripts read as 'no attempt used'."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, clarify-rejects-unsolvable-test job, near its "Cleanup negative-test issue" step (line 4919)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Cancel-on-gate-cancel steps were added only to orphan-workflows-test (4097), validate-standalone-test (4662), e2e-smoke-test (3022/3014) and e2e-alt-model-test (5290/5282), and orchestrate-decompose-test already cancels in its always() cleanup (4436). clarify-rejects-unsolvable-test creates an issue that starts a Clarify run (4735-4765), but no hunk adds a `--cancel-issue-runs` call or equivalent; a grep over the job's 4697-4934 range returns none. Its always() cleanup (4919-4939) only closes the issue, so the queued Clarify run keeps waiting for a runner after a runner-wait self-cancel. The prior deferral covers only the workflow-log-analysis child.
- requirement: G3: "The gate then stops early, cancels the child runs it started."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, workflow-log-analysis-test cancellation cleanup
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The job dispatches `workflow-log-analysis.yml` with `--snapshot-only` at lines 3669-3724 and exposes the child run ID, but the PR adds no cancellation step for that child. (anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly did not raise this gap, citing a prior editor deferral: the snapshot-only child finishes within minutes.)
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:dispatch_watch_alt_model_runner_wait, queued-candidate loop | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `alt_rw_ids="${alt_rw_ids:+${alt_rw_ids},}${alt_rw_id}"` runs before the held check, so a held queued run lands in both alt_rw_ids and alt_rw_held_ids (the test expects `runs=51,52 held_behind_runner_wait=51`). On a stop it is cancel-POSTed twice, and if listed first it is passed to `dispatch_watch_stop_release_gate "${alt_rw_ids%%,*}"` as watched_run.
  WHY: It produces a spurious "::warning::Could not cancel alt-model run #<id> after the runner wait" and a RELEASE_GATE_RUNNER_WAIT line that can name a held run. Fix: append after the held `continue`, or dedupe alt_rw_all.
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:dispatch_watch_cancel_issue_runs | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Each status listing reads only the first page of 100 runs repo-wide, with no total_count check and no second page; the alt-model check does guard this via `listing_truncated`.
  WHY: In a deep queue, the test issue's older queued runs sit past page 1 and are silently left holding runner slots. Fix: read total_count, then page further or print `::warning::`.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:line 3022 (e2e-smoke-test) and line 5290 (e2e-alt-model-test) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `if: cancelled()` cancel step sits after earlier `if: always()` steps, including the Phase 1b–7b soft-error analysers, "Verify all phases passed" and the LLM-calling analysers before 5285.
  WHY: Cleanup of the child runs is delayed while runner capacity is short. Moving each step to right after its job's wait step would still pass the wiring test.
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:dispatch_watch_cancel_issue_runs header comment / `select(((.display_title // "") | tostring) == $title)`; README DISPATCH_WATCH_STOP_RELEASE_GATE row; agents.d fragment | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Review runs carry the PR title ("AI implementation for issue #N"), so the title filter never matches them, yet the docs claim review runs are covered.
  WHY: There is no crash, because cancel_on_pr_close frees review runs after the always() cleanup closes the PR. The docs misstate the scope.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: G3: "The gate then stops early, cancels the child runs it started, and the cycle ends with a conclusion the release scripts read as 'no attempt used'."
  Expected change site: the clarify-rejects-unsolvable-test job in .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, next to its "Cleanup negative-test issue" step (line 4919).
  Evidence of absence: Cancel steps were added to orphan-workflows-test (line 4097), validate-standalone-test (line 4662), e2e-smoke-test (line 3022) and e2e-alt-model-test (line 5290), and orchestrate-decompose-test already cancels (line 4436). No `--cancel-issue-runs` call exists for clarify-rejects-unsolvable-test, whose always() cleanup (lines 4919-4939) only PATCHes the issue closed.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- Note: did not raise the workflow-log-analysis-test child gap, citing the prior editor deferral (snapshot-only child finishes within minutes). Security section: no issues; the cancel steps use the existing GH_TOKEN/TEST_REPO scope, validated inputs and `|| true`.
- HARDENING (2 related items): dedupe ids in the alt_rw_all stop loop with an `alt_rw_seen` case check (3 lines); warn when a dispatch_watch_cancel_issue_runs listing's `.total_count` exceeds 100 (3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
